name: Aggem Thorncurse
summary: In Razorfen Kraul, Aggem Thorncurse bears the title Death's Head Prophet. He calls a boar spirit to his aid when threatened.

sections.title: The Death's Head Prophet
sections.body: Aggem guards part of Razorfen Kraul, where the Death's Head tribe dwells. His shamanic power lets him summon a boar spirit, reflecting the quilboar's reverence for Agamaggan.

faq.answer: Aggem is a quilboar shaman and Death's Head Prophet in Razorfen Kraul.

faq.q: Where can Aggem Thorncurse be found?
faq.answer: Aggem is found inside Razorfen Kraul in the southern Barrens.

faq.q: What spirit does Aggem call upon?
faq.answer: Aggem summons a boar spirit to fight beside him.

faq.q: How does Aggem fight in combat?
faq.answer: Aggem uses shamanic magic and calls a boar spirit to fight beside him.

faq.q: Is Aggem Thorncurse affiliated with a specific quilboar tribe?
faq.answer: Aggem belongs to the Death's Head tribe.

angles.text: As a shaman, you see Aggem call a boar spirit to aid him, a distinctive expression of quilboar shamanism.
As a priest, you hear Aggem's title of prophet, which reflects the spiritual traditions of the quilboar.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure Durotar and Mulgore by putting down persistent defenders like Aggem Thorncurse, while the quilboar menace the Barrens.
